title: Conecuh Sausage Company Inc
description: Conecuh Sausage, a family-owned sausage company in Alabama, is known for its hickory-smoked pork sausages made with a proprietary, closely guarded seasoning blend. However, due to a lax approach to security, customer data, payment information, secret recipes/intellectual property, projects, personnel records, and supplier contracts were compromised and are now exposed. This information breach will result in legal notice/fines, financial losses, reputational damage, and loss of competitive advantage.
